domain: Pseudospectral T^3, N<=16, IC with |k|_inf <= k_shell only (evolution may leave the shell). NOT continuum PDE.
statement: For all divergence-free Fourier ICs on N^3 (N≤16) with |k|_∞ ≤ 4, kinetic energy = 0.5, evolved with dealiased ETD-RK2 (ν=0.1, dt=1e-3) to T=0.02, the enstrophy Ω(T) ≤ M with M=8.894923676246325. FINITE-DIMENSIONAL; IC shell only (flow may excite higher modes).
clay_implication: None. Shell-restricted IC class; does not address Clay Routes A-D.
